fields.sentence: Why do the villagers consider the Cove Stair unlucky?

q2_gaps: active attitude verb with an object + predicative complement ("the villagers consider the Cove Stair unlucky"): Propositional attitudes restricts sealing to a finite that-clause, and "consider" is covered only in the passive impersonal "X is considered to be P" shape (which has no Experiencer), so an active small clause with a stated holder has no stated routing
review.notes: Judged against the nearest licensed pattern the query is well formed: one line, ReasonFor conjoined on the focus event, $tv unpinned, the name bound by Name, the group bound by GroupOf, and the sealed complement rebuilt as the attitude QA pattern prescribes. (Member $c stair) is an extra constraint on an already Name-bound referent - harmless because Names and casing mandates that type atom, but not called for by the query rules.
